# A single document marking in its front matter

A single HTML document that is not a book chapter, with one index mark in each
of three YAML front-matter fields and one in its body. It is the control for
the book-chapter rule: here every front-matter mark keeps its anchor, and the
index links to each one by a fragment, because the page prints the three
fields in its own title block. The body marks a term too: [Capstan]{.index}.
